themes.label: 考试与评分
themes.selection: 选课前核对当期考试权重和题型，评估它与同学期其他课程的考试安排。
themes.study: 尽早确认考试范围与题型，复习时做限时练习，不只背熟已有答案。

themes.label: 作业与项目
themes.selection: 把作业和项目放进整学期时间表，再决定是否与其他任务密集的课程同修。
themes.study: 拿到任务后先拆分里程碑，尽早做出可检查的初稿，预留修改时间。

themes.label: 阅读与表达
themes.selection: 如果本学期已有多门阅读或汇报课程，先比较各门课的交付时间再组合。
themes.study: 读材料时记录论点和依据；写作或汇报先列提纲，再检查表达与引用。

sections.content: The content is mainly about different types of information systems, what problems they can address, and how managers should make decisions, along with many case studies.
sections.teaching: Great teaching. He is good at inspring students. Maybe the best teacher at UST. The class is quite engaging.
sections.grading: The exam is not difficult. It is not hard to pass the course, but getting A needs more efforts in writing reports and need to participate in the class more actively.
sections.workload: There are pre-readings and quiz each week. Two assignments. Sometimes presentations are needed.
